summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that Smackover Lithium (a partnership with Equinor) signed a binding take-or-pay offtake agreement with LG Energy Solution for 8,000 metric tonnes per year of battery-quality lithium carbonate over 10 years from the South West Arkansas Project. This is a routine commercial contract disclosure, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic restructuring are involved. The filing confirms progress toward project financing but does not trigger any M&A, capital return, or activist classification.
